title: Twitch CEO Predicts GTA 6 Online Next Year Amid Rockstar's Silence
description: Rockstar remains tight-lipped about GTA 6's online multiplayer mode, but Twitch's CEO speculates it could launch next year. The game drops on Nov 19 with campaign only.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Multiplayer: Rockstar Stays Silent While Twitch CEO Weighs In

As the release date for *Grand Theft Auto VI* approaches, the gaming community is buzzing with speculation about what the sequel's online experience will look like. According to a recent report by Eurogamer, Rockstar Games has remained remarkably tight-lipped regarding the potential successor to the immensely popular *Grand Theft Auto Online*. The developer has not yet even confirmed whether a multiplayer mode will officially launch.

At present, the only concrete detail we have regarding the game's launch is its scheduled arrival date: November 19th. When the title drops, it will strictly include the single-player campaign, leaving fans to wonder when—or if—they will be able to take their criminal enterprises online with friends.

## Industry Speculation and Precedent

In the absence of official statements from Rockstar, industry figures have begun offering their own perspectives. Notably, Twitch's CEO has chimed in on the matter, publicly stating an expectation that the multiplayer component will likely land next year.

While this prediction aligns with how Rockstar handled the rollout of *Grand Theft Auto V*—where the online mode followed the single-player release to give players time to experience the story—it is important to note that this is purely external speculation. Rockstar itself has not released any timeline, roadmap, or official confirmation regarding a multiplayer rollout for GTA 6.

## Editor's Take

It is hardly surprising that industry leaders are weighing in on one of the biggest gaming launches in history. While Twitch's CEO predicting a launch next year makes logical sense given past industry trends, players should temper their expectations until Rockstar officially breaks its silence. Until then, November 19th remains firmly focused on the single-player campaign.
